summary: The CKGSB-IE University report on Chinese companies going global is set to launch on September 15 in Singapore, with final preparations underway, while the team also manages an Outlook account lockout and advances the knowledge website redesign and global marketing strategy.
summaryDetail: The most urgent priority is the September 15 launch of the CKGSB-IE University report at the Tech in Asia Conference in Singapore, requiring finalization of the one-page flyer, webpage launch, press release edits, and confirmation of speaker details and guest approvals. This week, the team must resolve the Outlook account lockout by deleting and re-adding accounts on all devices with new passwords, and Joseph must share the HTML file for the knowledge website redesign so feedback can be marked. The knowledge website redesign is progressing, with decisions to remove the video section, integrate videos into topics, and bring indices like BCI to the homepage. The global marketing strategy is focusing on China-based programs Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO and content optimization, with a plan to be drafted and conversion tracking to be audited. Upcoming tasks include drafting a Chinese email to update Chen Zongchao on the Singapore activities and finalizing the report webpage after approval.
